events_dates_chk.name: events_dates_chk
events_dates_chk.value: "events"."ends_on" IS NULL OR "events"."starts_on" IS NULL OR "events"."ends_on" >= "events"."starts_on"

orders_staff_idem_uq.name: orders_staff_idem_uq
orders_staff_idem_uq.where: "orders"."idempotency_key" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."guest_session_id" IS NULL

orders_origin_chk.name: orders_origin_chk
orders_origin_chk.value: ("orders"."guest_session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."created_by_staff" IS NULL) OR ("orders"."guest_session_id" IS NULL AND "orders"."created_by_staff" IS NOT NULL)

orders_kind_chk.name: orders_kind_chk
orders_kind_chk.value: ("orders"."kind" = 'guest' AND "orders"."guest_session_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("orders"."kind" IN ('staff_table','walkin','staff_meal') AND "orders"."created_by_staff" IS NOT NULL)

staff_secret_chk.name: staff_secret_chk
staff_secret_chk.value: "staff"."password_hash" IS NOT NULL OR "staff"."pin_hash" IS NOT NULL OR "staff"."event_id" IS NOT NULL

cash_sessions_closed_chk.name: cash_sessions_closed_chk
cash_sessions_closed_chk.value: ("cash_sessions"."closed_at" IS NULL) = ("cash_sessions"."counted_cents" IS NULL) AND ("cash_sessions"."closed_at" IS NULL) = ("cash_sessions"."expected_cents" IS NULL)

price_rules_value_chk.name: price_rules_value_chk
price_rules_value_chk.value: ("price_rules"."kind" = 'fixed' AND "price_rules"."value" >= 0) OR ("price_rules"."kind" = 'percent' AND "price_rules"."value" BETWEEN 1 AND 100) OR ("price_rules"."kind" = 'amount' AND "price_rules"."value" >= 1)

price_rules_dates_chk.name: price_rules_dates_chk
price_rules_dates_chk.value: "price_rules"."valid_to" IS NULL OR "price_rules"."valid_from" IS NULL OR "price_rules"."valid_to" >= "price_rules"."valid_from"
